E1 is a general introduction to lightweight HEA design, and E2 only states an aim to investigate Mg content effects on microstructure and corrosion, without reporting results that support the proposed mechanism.
premises: Non-equilibrium Mg-containing lightweight HEA can be produced with a metastable solid-solution state
Controlled thermal exposure drives nucleation and growth of stable intermetallic compounds from the metastable state

A more protective surface film reduces corrosion current density and alters high-temperature oxidation kinetics
